answer: A plume of fake peers can surround a trading agent and replace its market signal with hollow quotes. Limit its connection table to one peer per IPv4 /24 or IPv6 /48 block and two per autonomous system, checked against routing data. Select outbound peers across those groups rather than sampling account names. A farm on one cloud network cannot fill every slot by generating keys; wider coverage requires access to more independently routed networks. This reduces eclipse attacks, but shared hosting hurts honest peers and routing diversity does not prove independent owners.
